paragraphs: My name is Leo. I'm eight years old. I'm the son of Mom and Dad. Can you see my building? It has four floors and one small elevator. My family lives here. Every morning, I go down to the ground floor. Uncle Nick and Aunt Sue have a shop there. I say hello to my uncle and my aunt.

My cousin Eva lives on the second floor. She lives with her parents, Uncle Nick and Aunt Sue. Eva is ten, and she is a very good friend. My mom, my dad, and I live on the third floor. We have a small balcony with a lot of flowers. My grandmother lives at the top. She has a big kitchen and a nice sofa. I love her rice.

On Sunday, everyone goes up to Grandma's for lunch. The elevator is small. Only four people can go in. The grown-ups go first. Then Eva and I go up. Uncle Nick says, "I don't need the elevator!" He walks up, and we all laugh. I don't have a brother or a sister. But I have a big family in one building. I'm a happy boy!
text.summary: Leo tells us about his family. They all live in one building, from the shop on the ground floor to Grandma at the top.
